cardDesc: Probabilistic temperature forecasting across 100+ stations using 21 NWP ensemble models.
title: Volatile Weather Temperature Nowcasting
overview: A probabilistic temperature forecasting system that ingests output from 21 NWP models across 100+ ASOS/METAR stations. Uses ensemble spread analysis and IQR-based model ranking to outperform NWS and commercial baselines on edge cases like marine-layer and boundary-layer regimes.
details: Ensemble spread analysis with IQR-based model ranking for dynamic weighting
12 city-specific microclimate models covering boundary-layer, marine-layer, solar/stability regimes
Forecast reliability validated via freshness rules, staleness discounting, and geospatial cross-referencing
Demonstrated superior edge-case accuracy over NWS and commercial baselines
